AboutPage.title: Su Wane ne Mu
AboutPage.subtitle: AOSSIE (Ƙirƙira da Ilimin Manhajar Buɗaɗɗen Tushe ta Ostiraliya) ƙungiya ce mai zaman kanta mara riba da aka yi wa rajista (ABN: 32 743 493 466), wadda ta sadaukar da kanta ga bincike da haɓaka manhajoji kyauta masu buɗaɗɗen tushe, da kuma koyar da ƙaʼidoji da hanyoyin haɓaka manhajar buɗaɗɗen tushe. Ayyukanmu kullum suna mai da hankali ne kan ƙirƙira, kuma sau da yawa suna buƙatar zurfin bincike. Dukkan ɗakunan karatun manhajarmu (libraries) da manhajojinmu kyauta ne kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe ne ɗari bisa ɗari.
AboutPage.pillarsTitle: Abin da Muka Tsaya a Kai
AboutPage.p1Desc: Ayyukanmu suna mai da hankali kan ƙirƙira kuma suna dogara sosai kan bincike, tun daga stablecoins da aka tabbatar da ingancinsu ta hanyar lissafi har zuwa AI mai kare sirri da ke aiki a kan naʼurarka.
AboutPage.p2Desc: Muna koyar da ƙaʼidoji da hanyoyin haɓaka manhajar buɗaɗɗen tushe ta hanyar jagorantar masu bayar da gudummawa a cikin ayyuka na gaske da shirye-shirye kamar Google Summer of Code.
AboutPage.p3Desc: Kowane ɗakin karatu da manhajar da muke ginawa kyauta ne kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe ne ɗari bisa ɗari, wanda muke haɓakawa a fili tare da alʼummarmu.
AboutPage.partnersTitle: Masu Ɗaukar Nauyi, Abokan Hulɗa da Masu Goyon Baya
AboutPage.partnersSubtitle: AOSSIE tana samun damar yin aiki ne saboda ƙungiyoyin da ke ɗaukar nauyin masu bayar da gudummawarmu kuma suke haɗa kai da mu a kan manhajoji kyauta masu buɗaɗɗen tushe.
AboutPage.partnerProjects: {count, plural, one {aiki # a cikin maʼajiyoyinta} other {ayyuka # a cikin maʼajiyoyinta}}
AboutPage.gsocDesc: Google Summer of Code shiri ne na Google a duniya baki ɗaya wanda ke ɗaukar nauyin sababbin masu bayar da gudummawa don yin aiki a kan ayyukan buɗaɗɗen tushe ƙarƙashin jagorancin masu jagoranci. AOSSIE ta shiga a matsayin ƙungiyar jagoranci tun shekarar 2016, kuma ita ce ƙungiya ta 10 mafi girma a duniya bisa yawan ayyukan GSoC da aka kammala.
AboutPage.stabilityDesc: Stability Nexus tana gina fasahar blockchain don samar da daidaito a tattalin arziki da harkokin kuɗi. Ta yi hulɗa da AOSSIE, kuma an haɓaka wasu daga cikin ayyukanmu na Google Summer of Code, kamar oracles, kasuwannin musaya da kayan tara kuɗi, a cikin ƙungiyar Stability Nexus ta GitHub.
AboutPage.djedDesc: Djed Alliance tana tallafa wa Djed, wata ƙaʼidar stablecoin da aka tabbatar da ingancinta ta hanyar lissafi. Ta haɗa kai da AOSSIE, kuma an haɓaka wasu daga cikin ayyukanmu na Google Summer of Code, ciki har da aiwatar da ƙaʼidar Djed da widget ɗin biyan kuɗi na StablePay, a cikin ƙungiyar Djed Alliance ta GitHub.
AboutPage.waysSubtitle: Akwai hanyoyi da dama da ƙungiyarku za ta iya aiki tare da mu. Ku tuntuɓe mu, za mu nemo wadda ta fi dacewa.
AboutPage.way1Desc: Ku ɗauki nauyin shirye-shiryen jagoranci ga sababbin masu bayar da gudummawa, kamar Australian Winter of Code wanda muke neman masu ɗaukar nauyi domin shirya shi.
AboutPage.way2Desc: Ku yi hulɗa da mu a fannin bincike da haɓakawa. Masu bayar da gudummawa da masu jagorancinmu za su iya gina ayyukan buɗaɗɗen tushe tare da tawagarku.
AboutPage.way3Desc: Ku samar da ayyuka, kayan aiki ko albarkatun da ke taimaka wa masu jagoranci da masu bayar da gudummawarmu wajen gina, gwadawa da fitar da manhajoji kyauta.

GrowthChart.title: Haɓaka da Tasirin Buɗaɗɗen Tushe
GrowthChart.subtitle: Ayyuka da shirye-shiryen manhaja da aka kammala aka fitar a kowace shekara tun 2016

Timeline.title: Tafiyarmu
Timeline.subtitle: Sama da shekaru goma muna ƙarfafa masu bayar da gudummawa don samar da tasiri mai kyau.
Timeline.m1Desc: Uku daga cikin ayyukan farko guda huɗu na AOSSIE (Skeptik/Scavenger, Carbon Footprint for Google Maps, da Mind the Word) Dr. Bruno Woltzenlogel Paleo ne ya aiwatar da su, kuma suka fara shiga GSoC ƙarƙashin ƙungiyar CSE@TU-Wien.
Timeline.m2Desc: Dr. Bruno Woltzenlogel Paleo ya kafa Ƙirƙira da Ilimin Manhajar Buɗaɗɗen Tushe ta Ostiraliya (AOSSIE).
Timeline.m3Desc: AOSSIE ta shiga Google Summer of Code da kanta a karon farko, tana jagorantar ɗalibai a faɗin duniya. Aikin zaɓe na lantarki mai suna Agora ya zama aiki na huɗu kuma babban aikin AOSSIE.
Timeline.m4Desc: An yi wa AOSSIE rajista a matsayin ƙungiya mara riba a Ostiraliya (ABN: 32 743 493 466) ƙarƙashin Hukumar Ƙungiyoyin Agaji da Ƙungiyoyi Marasa Riba ta Ostiraliya (ACNC).
Timeline.m5Desc: AOSSIE ta fara faɗaɗa tsarinta sosai da sababbin ayyuka masu amfani da blockchain da AI.
Timeline.m6Title: Ƙungiyar GSoC ta 10 Mafi Girma a Duniya
Timeline.m6Desc: AOSSIE ta zama ƙungiya ta 10 mafi girma a duniya, duka bisa yawan ayyukan GSoC da aka kammala a kowace shekara da kuma jimillar ayyukan da aka kammala, cikin ƙungiyoyi sama da 600.

Team.title: Tawagarmu da Alʼummarmu
Team.subtitle: AOSSIE tana gudana ne da kanta ta hannun rukunin masu aikin sa-kai masu ƙwazo, waɗanda suka haɗa da masu gudanarwa, masu kula da ayyuka, masu jagoranci, masu bayar da gudummawa da membobin alʼumma.
Team.r1Desc: Suna jagorantar alƙiblar ayyuka, bitar tsarin gine-ginen manhaja, da kayayyakin aikin buɗaɗɗen tushe.
Team.r2Desc: Suna jagorantar ɗalibai a GSoC, bitar code, rubuta shawarwarin ayyuka, da haɓaka ƙwarewar fasaha.
Team.r3Title: Masu Bayar da Gudummawa Masu Himma
Team.r3Desc: Suna gabatar da pull requests, gyara kurakurai, ƙara sababbin fasaloli, da rubuta takardun bayani.
Team.r4Desc: Suna haɗa kai a Discord, Telegram da GitHub don bunƙasa ƙirƙira a manhajoji masu buɗaɗɗen tushe.

ProgramsPage.title: Shirye-shirye
ProgramsPage.subtitle: Hanyoyin koyo, bayar da gudummawa da bunƙasa tare da AOSSIE.
ProgramsPage.gsocDesc: Google Summer of Code shiri ne na duniya da ke shigo da sababbin masu bayar da gudummawa cikin harkar haɓaka manhajoji masu buɗaɗɗen tushe. Masu bayar da gudummawa suna aiki a kan wani aiki ƙarƙashin jagorancin masu jagoranci daga wata ƙungiyar buɗaɗɗen tushe. AOSSIE ta shiga a matsayin ƙungiyar jagoranci tun shekarar 2016, kuma tana cikin manyan ƙungiyoyin GSoC a duniya.
ProgramsPage.gsocApply: Yadda ake nema tare da AOSSIE
ProgramsPage.internDesc: Muna shirye mu jagoranci masu horon aiki a kan kowane daga cikin ayyukanmu. Ku faɗa mana a Discord aikin da kuke son yi, za mu haɗa ku da masu jagorancinsa.
ProgramsPage.awocDesc: Muna neman masu ɗaukar nauyi da abokan hulɗa don shirya Australian Winter of Code, wani shirin buɗaɗɗen tushe mai jagoranci irin na GSoC. Idan ƙungiyarku na son taimakawa wajen tabbatar da shi, ku tuntuɓe mu.

Stats.title: Tasirinmu Mai Kyau a Alƙaluma
Stats.subtitle: Mu ne ƙungiya ta 10 mafi girma a duniya (cikin ƙungiyoyi sama da 600) bisa jimillar ayyukan Google Summer of Code da aka kammala.
Stats.mainStatDesc: Muna ƙarfafa masu haɓaka manhaja da ɗalibai don gina amintattun manhajoji masu buɗaɗɗen tushe tun shekarar 2016.
Stats.stat1Desc: Muna gina sababbin hanyoyin buɗaɗɗen tushe a fannonin kuɗi, ilimi da shugabanci.
Stats.stat2Desc: Shiga alʼummarmu ta masu haɓaka manhaja a duniya don haɗa kai, musayar raʼayoyi da bunƙasa tare.
Stats.stat3Desc: Maʼajiyoyi masu aiki da ke ɗauke da frameworks, ɗakunan karatu (libraries) da kayan aiki na zamani.
